newsitem.title: UK: Odds cut on Clarke in UK Conservative party race.
newsitem.headline: Odds cut on Clarke in UK Conservative party race.

text.p: British bookmakers William Hill said it cut the odds on Kenneth Clarke becoming the next leader of the Conservative Party and made him favourite to succeed John Major.
Clarke is quoted at 5-6 from 6-5, pushing the odds on William Hague out to 6-5. The change followed Stephen Dorrell's decision to withdraw from the race and, according to media reports, back Clarke.
Peter Lilley is quoted at 11-2, Michael Howard at 16-1 and John Redwood at 33-1.
